- Atelectasis was noted in the left lung base in one instance, often associated with low lung volumes.
- Cardiomegaly was described as being at the upper limits of normal or mildly enlarged in certain views.
- Lung opacity, lung lesions, pleural effusions, and fractures were explicitly not identified in the provided evidence.
